listing_text.short_description: Direct device-to-device mesh connectivity. Zero logs, sovereign identity, kernel-grade encryption.
listing_text.promotional_text: Connect directly to your devices anywhere in the world. No middleman. No traffic logs.
listing_text.full_description:
Zoop is a modern, open-source peer-to-peer mesh networking platform engineered for high-speed direct device connectivity and privacy.

Key Features:
• Sovereign Identity: Generate your decentralized Ed25519 identity protected by BIP-39 24-word recovery seeds. No phone numbers, passwords, or emails required.
• Direct P2P Mesh: High-performance WireGuard tunnels connect your phone, laptop, and home server directly through NATs with automated STUN/ICE traversal.
• Zero Traffic Logging: We never inspect, record, or track your traffic, browsing destinations, or DNS queries.
• IPv6 & DNS Leak Defenses: Built-in sinkhole routing and strictly bound resolvers prevent traffic leakage across network transitions.
• Dual Operational Modes: Switch between Recipient Mode (browse through trusted personal gateways) and Provider Mode (safely share internet egress with personal devices or team members).
• Autonomous Network Self-Healing: Real-time dead-peer detection with automatic failover to encrypted relay fallback when direct paths are temporarily blocked.

release.release_notes:
Official 1.0.0 release of Zoop:
- Decentralized Ed25519 identity & BIP-39 phrase recovery
- Android VpnService & WireGuard tunnel integration
- Direct P2P NAT hole-punching and encrypted relay failover
- In-app diagnostics (NAT type classification, PMTU discovery, DNS leak test)
- Zero-log, privacy-preserving troubleshooting bundles
